modifications: Adapt selected group/stream/event response fields and create/delete/put/get lifecycle to existing provider-owned SQLite state
Replace map/JSON persistence and UUID dependency with atomic SQL transactions and host-generated opaque generations
Persist original ingestion timestamps; exclusive endTime; deterministic event-time/insertion ordering
Enforce current AWS batch size/count/order/time boundaries and partial old/future rejection metadata
Ignore deprecated sequenceToken as required by current AWS behavior
Replace fresh UUID pagination placeholders with durable HMAC-authenticated, scoped, expiring cursors
Require host IAM callback on each request and scope group/stream ARNs to the selected region
Reject unsupported retention, tags, KMS, non-Standard classes, cross-account and automatic Lambda delivery rather than representing partial success

localStackReview.decision: Reference review only. Core ingest/query delegates to moto; no LocalStack or moto source, dependency, image or runtime copied. Python/moto backend does not match the Go single-binary SQLite contract.
